note: Adapted from Emerson 1925; original in English; the row labels of the measurement table are damaged by OCR ("TEL ORIO OVC onus" etc.); of these, the rows for eye diameter 0.26—0.27 mm and hind tibia length 1.07 mm are inferred from the fixed row order of the measurement table in that work, the remaining row labels are legible; all values are transcribed verbatim.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The soldier is very close to N. convexifrons (Holmgren), from which it differs in the narrower nasus. In the key the species falls in the branch "soldier with the profile from the tip of the nasus to the vertex convex", and it is the larger species, with soldier head length 1.73—1.83 mm and 13-segmented antennae.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head dark brown, oval. Fontanelle slit-like, longer than the ocelli, forked at the tip. Head hairy, with a few long setae. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 4 slightly larger than segment 2, segment 3 larger than segment 4. Eyes rather large and protruding, quite close to the lower margin of the head. Ocelli rather large, about 1/4 of their width from the eyes. Postclypeus slightly paler than the head, median line indistinct. Pronotum slightly paler than the head; posterior margins of the mesonotum and metanotum broadly concave. Wings smoky, with a pale stripe between the media and the cubitus, the wing membrane hairy and with pigment dots. Abdominal tergites about concolorous with the pronotum. Measurements (mm): length with wings 9.00—9.25; length without wings 5.00—6.00; head length 0.93—1.00; head width 0.83—0.87; eye diameter 0.26—0.27; pronotum length 0.40—0.46; pronotum width 0.67—0.74; hind tibia length 1.07; forewing length 6.83—7.50; forewing width 1.93—2.10.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellow, nearly circular from above except for the nasus, with a shallow groove on the posterior margin, the profile convex. Head covered with very short hairs, with 2 longer setae on the vertex; setae at the base of the nasus present or absent. Antennae 11-segmented, segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2, segment 4 about as long as segment 2. Nasus brown, darker than the head, covered with short hairs, narrower than in N. convexifrons. Pronotum pale, the anterior margin emarginate. Abdomen taking the colour of the gut contents; tergites with short hairs, without marginal setae.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Type locality: Kartabo, British Guiana; distribution known only from the type locality. The holotype is a soldier and the morphotype an alate; the description is based on many soldiers and alates collected by the author in six different colonies at Kartabo. The specific name honours Wm. M. Mann of the United States National Museum.
